tools.name: list_peopleanalyst_feeds
tools.description: List PeopleAnalyst's free machine-readable feeds and their MCP/REST availability. OpenAPI is also published at https://peopleanalyst.com/openapi.json.

tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: Returns the full index of authored /answers pages — one entry per slug, with the question and canonical URL. Use this to discover available slugs before calling get_answer.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns one authored /answers page as structured content: question, markdown answer body (short answer, problem frame, evidence, grounded sources), and citations with libraryId or url. Known slugs (33): measure-employee-performance, survey-validity-check, people-analytics-program-maturity, people-an

tools.name: get_product_description
tools.description: Machine-readable description of each PeopleAnalyst product. Versioned, CORS-open descriptions of every product in the portfolio — general positioning plus structured personas, goals, problems, journeys, and associated BrandScripts where the product has that canon. Assembled from source records. Pass

tools.name: get_marketing_registry
tools.description: The Pitboss marketing-asset registry (typed cards + personas). Cross-site marketing-asset cards built from the portfolio's brandscripts and proofs, plus the persona set. ?product filters to one product; ?status filters by lifecycle.

tools.name: get_brandscripts
tools.description: Per-persona StoryBrand arguments for each product. The persona × goal argument layer (SB7-shaped). Stable ?id is globally exact; ?product + ?persona + ?variant selects one exact scoped variant, while ?variant alone remains a compatible filter. Live is the default; ?status=draft|all opts into authori

tools.name: get_story_tracks
tools.description: Pre-authored data-story tracks — the possibility space. Complete data stories: the SB7 argument, the acts and beats that carry it, the branches it forks down, the decision it produces, and the data required to test it. Candidates only — nothing here asserts a story is true of any organisation; that

tools.name: get_scene_templates
tools.description: Falsifiable scene templates — one claim plus what would make it false. The cards a story is told with. Each declares truth conditions the data can falsify, so a claim survives on evidence rather than assertion. Persona relevance is derived from focus (a stated heuristic). Drafts excluded unless ?sta

tools.name: get_canonical_forms
tools.description: The canonical form vocabulary — the structural primitive. 7 data shapes and the 33 canonical forms they resolve to. The form is why one engine reads compensation, attrition, funnels and survey data without a per-domain rewrite: the domain is in the metric tag, the structure is here. 'oftenMeans' is

tools.name: get_claim_warrant
tools.description: How many works discuss a claim — discourse volume, with the works named. For a construct pair mined from the book corpus: how many distinct works discuss the link, and which ones, with each work's stated rationale. ⚠ This is DISCOURSE, not evidence — book frequency is confounded by publication incen

tools.name: get_library_ids
tools.description: Library id export — stable ids for the works homed here. Batch export of library_id rows (id, title, author, year, property tags) for the works that home on peopleanalyst.com. Ids are content-addressed (SHA-256 of normalized title|authors|year) and stable across repos, so a consumer can join to this

tools.name: run_segmentation
tools.description: Behavioral segmentation, role discovery, and exemplar matching. Deterministic segmentation over caller-supplied numeric vectors: cluster subjects, discover roles from behaviour + relationship edges, detect emergent roles, or match against exemplars. Structured non-biometric signals only — no audio,

tools.name: plan_next_data_ask
tools.description: What data to ask for next, and what it would rule out. The acquisition planner. Given which data-stories are still candidates, returns the single most efficient next question, the full ranked list, and the minimum set of asks that makes every live story testable — split into what can be sent today v

tools.name: get_insight_cards
tools.description: A pitch rendered as player-ready InsightCards. Serves a named pitch as an ordered InsightCard[] (the cross-site insight-player contract). ?pitch selects the pitch; ?awareness optionally reshapes the sequence for the buyer's awareness state.

tools.name: get_situations
tools.description: Demonstration scenarios (discovered → diagnosed → solved). The proof layer paired with brandscripts: concrete situations a product resolves. ?product filters; ?status opts into drafts.

tools.name: get_tools
tools.description: The PeopleAnalyst tool catalog (corpus-grounded acting tools). Machine-readable catalog of every corpus-grounded acting tool — name, category, what it does, inputs/outputs, concrete use cases, the profile URL, and how to run it (auth-gated REST + MCP). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_answers" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the full index of authored /answers pages — one entry per slug, with the question and canonical URL. Use this to discover available slugs before calling…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_membership_offer" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_product_description" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
